title: Kuala Lumpur Guan Di Temple
geometryBasis: Named OpenStreetMap property way 28215278, with street orientation from the western property line and location corroborated by the operator.
sectionBasis: The geotagged February 2007 Qualla original controls the tiled street frontage, ornamental gate and principal roof. The temple association documents the formal shrine hall and a rear two-storey school. Intermediate depths are estimated inside the mapped site.
limitations: The February 2007 Qualla photo establishes the street façade, recessed hall, roof, gateway and front fence. Roof ridge figures, plaques and door ornament are simplified at this scale.
The named map polygon represents the full property. Hall depths, the interior court and rear elevations are approximations. The two-storey rear building is documented by the temple association.

The original composite field includes a steep elevation anomaly across the property, consistent with nearby building returns. The dated placement opens terrain only within the paved site boundary. Original source elevations are retained and independently viewable. The modeled thresholds and adjoining street grade remain approximate.
